word_count.algorithm: Count non-empty whitespace-delimited units in normalized extracted text.
word_count.raw_word_count: Same count over extractor text before Clarion normalization.
word_count.normalized_word_count: Same count over normalized document text; this is the canonical UI word count.
word_count.punctuation: Attached punctuation stays with its unit; punctuation-only whitespace units count as units.
word_count.hyphenated_terms: One unit when no whitespace separates the term.
word_count.contractions: One unit when no whitespace separates the contraction.
word_count.numbers: One unit per whitespace-delimited number expression.
word_count.unicode: Any non-empty whitespace-delimited Unicode sequence counts as one unit.
word_count.headers_footers_tables: Count any text emitted by the extractor; headers/footers are not removed, and DOCX table rows are included.

pages.physical_pages: PDF page objects reported by the parser.
pages.extracted_pages: Pages where extraction did not raise an exception; an empty result still counts as extracted.
pages.text_bearing_pages: Successfully extracted pages whose raw text contains a non-whitespace character.
pages.empty_text_pages: Extracted pages without non-whitespace text; not asserted to be image-only.
pages.indexed_pages: Distinct page numbers appearing in retained chunk source provenance.
pages.ocr: Not available unless an OCR stage is separately configured; image-only pages are not labeled as OCR text.

chunks.candidate_raw_chunks: Unique pre-merge raw chunk IDs retained through merge lineage.
chunks.rejected_chunks: Null unless a pipeline stage persists a rejection count; not inferred by subtracting merged counts.

embedding.faiss_vectors: ntotal from a successfully loaded FAISS index whose vector IDs match the persisted mapping.
